text.description_html:
Fusion RH-C6, River Rock Oval Wall Mounted Robe Hook

This hook is a simple way to get your house organized. Hang one in the bathroom for your robe; and put a few of them by the front door as a catch-all for hats, scarves, coats, and bags. The River Rock Bronze Oval Robe Hook is available in medium bronze and dark bronze finishes. It is made by Fusion, a leader in hardware both for impeccable style and high quality products.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-C6 River Rock Towel Bar, Fusion TR-C6 River Rock Towel Ring, and Fusion PH-C6 River Rock Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion RH-C6 Bronze Oval Robe Hook:

  • Mount Width: 3"
  • Mount Length: 4-1/2"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
